questions.q: Werner's salary is 20% of his employer's salary. By what percentage should Werner's salary be increased to equal his employer's salary? / Gaji Werner ialah 20% daripada gaji majikannya. Berapakah peratus peningkatan gaji yang perlu diberikan kepada Werner untuk menyamai gaji majikannya?

Irene made a "city" with identical wooden cubes. The left diagram shows the view from above the "city" and the right diagram shows the view from one of the sides. However, it is not known from which side the side view was taken. What is the largest number of cubes that Irene could have used? / Irene membina sebuah "bandar" menggunakan kiub kayu yang sama saiz. Rajah kiri menunjukkan pandangan dari atas dan rajah kanan menunjukkan pandangan dari salah satu sisi, tetapi tidak diketahui dari sisi mana. Berapakah bilangan kiub paling banyak yang mungkin digunakan oleh Irene?

Aisha has a strip of paper with the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 written in five cells, as shown. She folds the strip several times so that the cells overlap, forming 5 layers. Which of the following configurations (from top layer to bottom layer) is not possible to obtain? / Aisha mempunyai jalur kertas dengan nombor 1, 2, 3, 4 dan 5 pada lima petak seperti yang ditunjukkan. Dia melipat jalur itu beberapa kali sehingga petak-petak bertindih membentuk 5 lapisan. Antara susunan berikut (dari lapisan atas ke bawah), yang manakah mustahil diperoleh?

Zaida took a square piece of paper and folded two of its sides to the diagonal to obtain a quadrilateral, as shown. What is the largest angle of the quadrilateral? / Zaida mengambil sekeping kertas segi empat sama dan melipat dua sisinya ke pepenjuru untuk membentuk suatu sisi empat, seperti yang ditunjukkan. Apakah sudut terbesar sisi empat tersebut?

How many four-digit numbers A are there such that half of A is divisible by 2, a third of A is divisible by 3, and a fifth of A is divisible by 5? / Berapakah bilangan nombor empat digit A supaya separuh daripada A boleh dibahagi dengan 2, satu pertiga daripada A boleh dibahagi dengan 3, dan satu perlima daripada A boleh dibahagi dengan 5?

In the final round of a music competition, each of the three members of the jury gives the five competitors 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 points. No two competitors get the same mark from any individual judge. Adam knows all the sums of the marks and a few single marks, as shown. How many points did Adam get from judge III? / Dalam pusingan akhir suatu pertandingan muzik, setiap tiga ahli juri memberi markah 0, 1, 2, 3 atau 4 kepada lima peserta. Tiada dua peserta mendapat markah yang sama daripada juri yang sama. Adam mengetahui jumlah markah semua peserta dan beberapa markah, seperti dalam jadual. Berapakah markah yang Adam dapat daripada juri III?

Sophia has 52 identical isosceles right-angled triangles. She wants to make a square using some of them. How many different sized squares can she make? / Sophia mempunyai 52 segi tiga sama kaki bersudut tegak yang kongruen. Dia mahu membuat segi empat sama menggunakan sebahagian daripadanya. Berapakah bilangan segi empat sama yang berbeza saiz yang boleh dibuatnya?

Anne, Boris and Carl ran a race. They started at the same time, and their speeds were constant. When Anne finished, Boris had 15 m left to run and Carl had 35 m left to run. When Boris finished, Carl had 22 m left to run. What is the race distance? / Anne, Boris dan Carl berlari dalam satu perlumbaan. Mereka bermula serentak dan kelajuan mereka tetap. Apabila Anne tamat, Boris mempunyai baki 15 m dan Carl baki 35 m. Apabila Boris tamat, Carl mempunyai baki 22 m. Apakah jarak perlumbaan?
